# Global Palate

> Global Palate is a U.S.-based B2B supplier of certified organic ingredients (turmeric, ashwagandha, moringa, ginger, tamarind and arrowroot) for manufacturers in the United States and Canada. Inventory is held in Compton, California. Every batch ships with a Certificate of Analysis.

## Products
- [Organic Turmeric Powder](https://globalpalate.co/product/organic-turmeric-powder/): 2–3% curcumin. Our highest-volume SKU for supplements, functional beverages and spice blends.
- [Organic Ashwagandha Root Powder](https://globalpalate.co/product/organic-ashwagandha-root-powder/): Root powder with 0.3% withanolides (HPLC), with documentation on request.
- [Organic Moringa Leaf Powder](https://globalpalate.co/product/organic-moringa-leaf-powder/): Fine-milled leaf powder for green blends, smoothie bases and functional foods.
- [Organic Ginger Powder](https://globalpalate.co/product/organic-ginger-powder/): Consistent pungency and color for beverages, spice blends and supplement formats.
- [Organic Tamarind Paste](https://globalpalate.co/product/organic-tamarind-paste-pulp/): Seedless paste sold by the drum, for sauces, condiments and beverage concentrates.
- [Organic Arrowroot Powder](https://globalpalate.co/product/organic-arrowroot-powder/): Neutral-tasting thickener for gluten-free and clean-label food manufacturing.
- [Turmeric for the West Coast](https://globalpalate.co/product/organic-turmeric-powder/west-coast/)
- [Turmeric for the East Coast](https://globalpalate.co/product/organic-turmeric-powder/east-coast/)

## Industries
- [Nutraceutical & Dietary Supplement](https://globalpalate.co/industries/nutraceutical-dietary-supplement/): Capsule, tablet and powder formulators sourcing botanicals with documentation behind every lot.
- [Functional Food & Beverage](https://globalpalate.co/industries/functional-food-beverage/): Manufacturers building turmeric lattes, wellness drinks and functional snack lines.
- [Herbal & Traditional Formulation](https://globalpalate.co/industries/herbal-traditional-formulation/): Herbal brands and traditional formulators who need clearly identified botanicals.
- [Spice & Seasoning](https://globalpalate.co/industries/spice-seasoning/): Blenders and packers sourcing bulk organic spice inputs.
